## C2 — Confusable pairs and knowledge-graph hints: Selective Service ages, donor decisions, litter penalties and golf cart limits
Confusable pairs among the state laws and golf cart rules in this section, with a few continuation facts; each block ties to one handbook page, and hint metadata sits only in the trailing line of a block.

FACT_ID: sec03-R01 | anchor: A01
Form 447-SEL is required for male applicants under 26, while the SCDMV only sends the data to Selective Service once the applicant reaches 18. [A01]
Why it matters: group selective service; confusable age twenty-six versus age eighteen.
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec03-R02 | anchor: A01
The Selective Service rule covers applications for a beginner's permit, a driver's license and an identification card alike. [A01]
Why it matters: group selective service; difficulty low.
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec03-R03 | anchor: A01
Registering as a donor is a legally binding agreement, yet for a registrant under 18 the parent or legal guardian makes the final decision. [A01]
Why it matters: group organ donation; confusable adult versus minor donor.
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec03-R04 | anchor: A02
A litter offender can face both a fine and a court order to pick up roadside litter under supervision. [A02]
Why it matters: group littering; confusable fine only versus fine plus cleanup.
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec03-R05 | anchor: A02
Paper cups, candy wrappers and bottles are the manual's examples of litter to collect in an in-vehicle container. [A02]
Why it matters: group littering; difficulty low.
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec03-R06 | anchor: A02
The golf cart minimum age of 16 also requires a valid driver's license, so age alone is not enough. [A02]
Why it matters: group golf carts; confusable age versus license requirement.
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec03-R07 | anchor: A03
The gate of a gated community can also serve as the starting point for the four-mile daytime golf cart limit. [A03]
Why it matters: group golf carts; confusable registration address versus gated community gate.
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec03-R08 | anchor: A03
Golf carts are limited to secondary streets and highways with posted limits of 35 mph or less, so any road posted faster is off limits. [A03]
Why it matters: group golf carts; difficulty medium.
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec03-R09 | anchor: A03
Large non-commercial vehicles and recreational vehicles share one separate SCDMV manual, while mopeds and motorcycles share another. [A03]
Why it matters: group other manuals; confusable which manual covers which vehicle.
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0031]

corpus_stability.reason: The South Carolina Driver's Manual prints a single edition line (Revised 06/2024) on its front cover; its disclaimer says legislative and SCDMV policy changes may make some content out of date until the agency incorporates them, and a possibly newer unlinked upload exists on the issuer site (freshness debt in the run jams), so the corpus is treated as revised at most about once a year, bound to the registered snapshot.
